summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its management information circular and notice of an annual general and special meeting scheduled for August 11, 2026. The meeting covers standard agenda items: receiving audited financials, reappointing the auditor, fixing board size at five, electing directors, and ratifying an amended shareholder rights plan. No transaction terms, prices, premiums, or special-situation event (e.g., M&A, tender, spin-off) are present. The filing is a routine Canadian meeting circular mapped to a U.S. 6-K. There is no deal or activist campaign to analyze; the risk-arb angle is not applicable.
